name: salpakan-online
description: Salpakan (Game of the Generals) — online multiplayer: authoritative Node.js arbiter + React client.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
